notes.title: Multiplayer Connection Fix
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where some users were unable to connect to multiplayer sessions.

- This was likely caused by network configuration conflicts, including proxy or firewall-related issues.

- The connection flow has been updated to improve compatibility across a wider range of network environments.

Let us know if you still experience any connectivity issues—your feedback helps us make the game better!

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes Update (v1.0.1)
notes.content: We've squashed a few pesky bugs in Perplex to improve your gameplay experience. While there are no major changes in this update, these behind-the-scenes tweaks help keep things running smoothly. Thanks for playing and stay tuned for more!
